name: extract_entities
description: Extract named entities (people, organizations, places, etc.) with their types. One row per entity per document.
prompt:
Extract all named entities from the text below.

TEXT:
{{text}}

Entity types:
- person: a named individual (e.g. "Maria Hernandez")
- org: an organization, company, or institution (e.g. "University of Helsinki")
- place: a location, city, country, or geographic feature
- event: a named event (e.g. "World Cup", "COVID pandemic")
- other: anything proper-noun-ish that doesn't fit above

For each entity, return:
- name: the entity as it appears in the text (don't normalize spelling)
- type: one of person, org, place, event, other
- mentions: how many times the entity appears in this text

Return JSON:

{
  "entities": [
    {"name": "...", "type": "person", "mentions": 1},
    ...
  ]
}

If no entities are present, return {"entities": []}. Don't invent entities not present in the text.

fields.name: mentions
fields.description: Number of mentions in this text
